ideas.name: S&P 500 option-expiration week effect
ideas.claim: S&P 500 returns averaged higher during weeks ending on the third Friday of the month than across all weeks.
ideas.quote: We nd that the mean return for the third Friday week is 37 basis points, more than double the average return for the full sample average of 15 basis points for all weeks.

rules.timeframe: Weekly, Friday to Friday; use the preceding available trading day when Friday prices are unavailable
rules.filters: Week ending on the third Friday of the month

ideas.claimed_result: July 1983–December 2008: mean third-Friday-week return was approximately 0.37%, versus 0.15% across all weeks; the reported spread versus other weeks was approximately 0.28 percentage points.
